text:
alex: Hey team — I pushed fixups for the allocator race and addressed @maya's comments. PTAL when you have a minute. CI was green locally but the pipeline has been flaky all morning.

maya: Looking now, thanks. Splitting the test into unit + smoke was a good call. Quick q: did you keep the older eviction config in case we need to roll back?

alex: Left the old eviction config behind a feature flag (evict_v2=false). Also added an e2e-only test guarded by `TEST_HEAVY=1` so it won't run in fast CI.

sam: PTAL from infra side — I need to make sure the canary pool isn't exhausted by the load test I'm running. Can we hold the merge until I confirm capacity? Prefer a 09:30 PT window.

alex: OK holding. I added smoke steps in the PR description: ```./scripts/smoke.sh --target=staging && curl -sS https://staging.redwood/health``` — run that after the canary deploy.

jordan: did a pass — a couple of nits about log levels and one optional rename. nothing blocking. :+1:

maya: I left one comment on the logging verbosity (too chatty at INFO for our longtail logs). If alex reduces to DEBUG for the hot path I can lgtm.

alex: reduced the hot-path logs to DEBUG, squashed, and force-pushed. Rebased onto main to pick up the latest canary fixes.

ci-bot: Build #7245 finished — ✅ all checks passed (unit, lint, quick-smoke).

sam: Thanks — I'm reserving the canary slot at 09:30 PT and will run a small capacity test before you merge. If anything spikes I'll ping here and request rollback.

maya: lgtm once the canary run completes and CI stays stable.

alex: thanks everyone. I'll merge after the canary window. Posting rollback steps in the PR description and will open a quick follow-up if we need to revert. :shipit:
thread_summary: Follow-up after addresssed CR comments: requester pushed fixes for allocator race, split tests, guarded e2e, requested PTAL, infra asked for canary window reservation, CI ok, agreed to merge after 09:30 PT canary
